name: Databricks
description: The Databricks logo mark. Use it to label the platform boundary in an architecture diagram.

name: Data Intelligence Platform
description: The unified platform for data engineering, analytics, AI and governance on one lakehouse foundation.

name: Lakehouse Architecture
description: Open architecture combining data lake economics with warehouse reliability and ACID management.

name: Apache Spark
description: Managed, autoscaling Apache Spark for large-scale batch, streaming and ML processing.

name: Photon
description: A native C++ vectorized query engine. It accelerates SQL and DataFrame work with no code changes.

name: Compute (Clusters)
description: All-purpose and job compute resources that run notebooks, pipelines and jobs.

name: Serverless Compute
description: Fully managed, versionless compute that starts in seconds and autoscales without cluster administration.

name: Databricks Runtime
description: An optimized runtime image with Spark, Delta and ML libraries. The ML variant adds GPU frameworks and AutoML.

name: Real-Time Mode for Apache Spark
description: Structured Streaming execution mode delivering millisecond latency for time-critical pipelines.

name: Multicloud Deployment
description: The same platform and governance model deployed across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.

name: Lakeflow
description: The unified data engineering suite covering ingestion, declarative transformation and orchestration.

name: Lakeflow Connect
description: Managed ingestion with 100+ connectors for SaaS applications, databases and cloud storage.

name: Zerobus Ingest
description: Broker-free streaming ingest over gRPC, REST and OpenTelemetry with roughly five-second freshness.

name: Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
aka: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines. Formerly Delta Live Tables (DLT)
description: Declarative batch and streaming ETL with built-in data quality expectations, CDC and dependency management.

name: Lakeflow Jobs
description: Native orchestration for data, analytics and AI workflows, with control flow, retries and alerting.

name: Lakeflow Designer
description: No-code, drag-and-drop pipeline authoring that generates governed, production-ready pipeline code.

name: Auto Loader
description: Incrementally and idempotently ingests new files from cloud object storage as they arrive.

name: Structured Streaming
description: The Apache Spark API for exactly-once stream processing in continuous, incremental pipelines.

name: Lakebridge
description: Migration tooling that profiles legacy warehouses, converts code to ANSI SQL and validates the results.

name: Delta Lake
description: Open table format adding ACID transactions, time travel and change data feed to object storage.

name: Apache Iceberg
description: First-class managed and foreign Iceberg tables, readable and writable through Unity and Iceberg REST catalogs.

name: Lakehouse Storage (Managed Tables)
description: Self-optimizing managed Delta and Iceberg tables with automatic layout, compaction and caching.

name: Liquid Clustering
description: Partition-free, self-tuning data layout that adapts clustering keys to real query patterns.

name: Predictive Optimization
description: AI-driven background maintenance that runs OPTIMIZE, VACUUM and statistics where they pay off most.

name: Lakebase
description: Serverless Postgres OLTP database with branching, scale-to-zero and native lakehouse sync for apps and agents.

name: Databricks Lakehouse (Data Warehousing)
description: Serverless data warehouse built on open table formats and governed by Unity Catalog.

name: Databricks SQL
description: The SQL surface of the lakehouse: warehouses, editor, queries, alerts and BI connectivity.

name: SQL Warehouse
description: Serverless, Photon-powered SQL compute endpoint for BI tools, dashboards and ad hoc queries.

name: Lakehouse//RT
description: Real-time warehouse tier serving millisecond queries at high concurrency directly on lake tables.

name: Databricks AI/BI
description: The built-in business intelligence experience spanning dashboards, Genie spaces and semantics.

name: AI/BI Dashboards
description: Dashboards with natural-language chart authoring and forecasting. Publication needs no separate license.

name: Lakehouse Federation
description: Query and govern external systems such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres and MySQL in place, without moving data.

name: Databricks Genie
description: The agentic AI experience that answers questions and acts on governed enterprise data.

name: Genie One
description: AI coworker hub where business users ask questions, get grounded answers and trigger agentic actions.

name: Genie Agents
description: Governed natural-language analytics spaces that answer business questions over curated data.

name: Genie Code
description: Agentic coding partner for data teams that builds pipelines, dashboards, notebooks and ML workflows.

name: Genie Deep Research
description: Multi-step research agent that investigates a question across governed data and returns a cited report.

name: Agent Bricks
description: Platform for building, evaluating and governing enterprise AI agents grounded in your own data.

name: Databricks AI Search
aka: formerly Databricks Vector Search / Mosaic AI Vector Search
description: Managed hybrid vector and BM25 search with auto-syncing indexes and built-in reranking.

name: Unity AI Gateway
description: Single control plane for model, MCP and agent access with guardrails, rate limits, budgets and audit.

name: Document Intelligence
description: SQL-native parsing, extraction and classification that turns PDFs and images into governed structured data.

name: Databricks Model Serving
description: Unified serverless endpoints for custom ML models, foundation models and agents, plus batch inference.

name: Databricks Model Training
description: Managed fine-tuning and custom model training on serverless H100 GPUs, without moving data.

name: Managed MLflow
description: Hosted MLflow for experiment tracking, GenAI tracing, evaluation and the Unity Catalog model registry.

name: Databricks Feature Store
description: Governed feature registry with batch and low-latency online serving, and training/serving consistency.

name: AI Functions
description: SQL functions such as ai_query, ai_classify and ai_extract that call models directly inside queries.

name: Databricks AutoML
description: Glass-box automated training that produces baseline models plus the editable notebooks that built them.

name: CustomerLake
description: Agentic customer data platform with identity resolution, Customer 360 and marketing agents, native to the lakehouse.

name: Unity Catalog
description: Unified governance for data, models, agents and MCP servers across clouds, under one permission model.

name: Unity Catalog Semantics
description: Central semantic layer of metric views and business definitions that grounds BI tools and AI agents.

name: Data & AI Lineage
description: Automatic column-level lineage across tables, dashboards, models and agents for impact analysis and audit.

name: Attribute-Based Access Control
description: Tag- and attribute-driven policies that enforce row, column and object permissions at scale.

name: Data Quality Monitoring
description: Automated profiling, freshness checks and anomaly detection over tables and inference logs.

name: Lakewatch
description: Open agentic SIEM for petabyte-scale security logs, detection-as-code and AI-assisted threat hunting.

name: System Tables
description: Built-in analytical tables exposing billing, usage, lineage, audit and job history for observability.

name: Enterprise Security
description: Network isolation, customer-managed keys, private connectivity and compliance controls for the workspace.

name: Delta Sharing
description: An open protocol for live, zero-copy data sharing across clouds, platforms and organizations.

name: OpenSharing
description: Linux Foundation standard extending governed sharing to data, models and agents across engines and clouds.

name: Databricks Marketplace
description: Open exchange for datasets, models, notebooks, dashboards and solution accelerators.

name: Databricks Clean Rooms
description: Privacy-safe multi-party collaboration on shared data with no raw-data access, across clouds.

name: Partner Connect
description: Guided setup that wires validated ingestion, BI and governance partner tools into your workspace.

name: Databricks Apps
description: Serverless hosting for Python data and AI apps built with Streamlit, Dash or Gradio, with Unity Catalog auth.

name: Databricks Notebooks
description: Collaborative multi-language notebooks with built-in visualisation, versioning and AI assistance.

name: Databricks Workspace
description: A collaborative environment. It groups the notebooks, queries, dashboards, jobs and files of each team.

name: Git Folders (Repos)
description: Workspace folders backed by Git for branch-based development and CI/CD.

name: Databricks Asset Bundles
description: Infrastructure-as-code packaging of jobs, pipelines and apps for repeatable multi-environment deploys.

name: Databricks CLI
description: Command-line client for workspaces, jobs, compute, Unity Catalog and bundle deployment.

name: Databricks Connect
description: Run local DataFrame code against remote Databricks compute from any IDE or application.

name: IDE Integrations
description: Official VS Code and PyCharm extensions for editing, syncing, running and debugging on Databricks.

name: REST API & SDKs
description: Programmatic control of every platform resource, with official Python, Java, Go and JavaScript SDKs.

name: Databricks Terraform Provider
description: Official Terraform provider for declaring workspaces, compute, Unity Catalog objects and permissions.
